name: Maren Tapered Track Pant
description: Tapered athleisure track pant in a smooth nylon-cotton blend with a subtle sheen. Elastic waist, zip side pockets, and a clean silhouette that works for a jog or a transit ride. Doesn't look like sweatpants — that's the point. Comes in black, charcoal, and deep teal.
functionality: Light moisture wicking; four-way stretch; zip-secure pockets
what_it_says: You value looking put-together even when you're being casual. You have somewhere to be, or at least act like it.
worn_by: people who work from home but still try
story_hooks: The zip pocket is just large enough to hold a folded paper note — the kind someone wants to pass without going digital.
A Tier 4 character dismisses someone in these as 'Tier 3 trying too hard,' which the wearer clocks and remembers.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, minimalist track pant with a modern athletic aesthetic that reads as elevated casual. The tapered leg creates a streamlined silhouette from hip to ankle, avoiding the bulk of traditional sweatpants. Sits at the natural waist with a subtle forward lean in the upper thigh.
physical_description.fit: Tapered through the leg with a relaxed hip and thigh; sits naturally at the waist without compression. Ankle opening is snug but not restrictive, allowing for movement or tucking into boots.
physical_description.primary_material: Nylon-cotton blend (approximately 70% nylon, 30% cotton) with a smooth, brushed finish on the interior
physical_description.texture: Smooth and satin-like on the exterior with a subtle sheen that catches light; interior is soft fleece or brushed cotton for thermal regulation
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep black as primary; secondary options include charcoal gray and deep teal. No patterns; solid colorways with tonal stitching
physical_description.closures: Elastic waist with internal drawcord for adjustment; two angled zip side pockets positioned at hip level
distinctive_features: Angled zip pockets with subtle branded metal pulls
Tapered ankle cuff with reinforced stitching
Tonal woven Maren brand label on back waistband
Flat-front construction with no aggressive seaming
Subtle reflective trim along outer leg seam (safety-functional)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 boundary: affordable quality for working professionals and upwardly mobile service sector workers; signals investment in appearance without excess
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by transit commuters, junior corpo staff, freelance creatives, and off-duty warehouse workers. Appeals to those balancing functionality with the need to look 'put together' in mixed social spaces. Not street; not chrome; intentionally mainstream-adjacent.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or lightly broken-in; minor fading at stress points after extended wear. No intentional distressing; aging is organic
